source.n8n_access: read-only GET /executions only; the poll loop has NEVER run on live (the media lane was promoted 2026-08-23 and the single media turn to date, exec 13584318, was answered synchronously by the CRM with status=completed, so media-poll-merge has zero captured traffic). Inputs are built from the GET /api/v1/external/media/jobs/{job_id} callback body the node's own header documents.
source.rationale: The ordinary happy poll: the CRM job finished between the synchronous 30 s wait and the first poll. `polledOk` is true (object, truthy `status`, no error), so every field is taken from the poll body: job_id/tier/notices/result pass through and `status` is String(resp.status). The node ALWAYS stamps decision='accepted' and quota=null — it is re-shaping a job-status body into the MediaProcessResponse shape media-route understands, and the job body carries neither. `_poll_n` is $runIndex+1 (=1 on the first poll), which is what makes media-route's MAX_POLLS guard un-defeatable by a stale $('...').first() read.
